description: TecMedHub: applied science lab from Universidad Austral de Chile (Puerto Montt). We solve real problems with technology, from the south. We bring AI and computer vision, 3D printing/CNC, augmented reality and prototyping, all open source. Looking for: data scientists (satellite/remote sensing data), Python/JS developers, UI/UX designers and storytellers. Curious minds from any field welcome. Spanish/English. tecmedhub.org
